GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Active Listening, Oral Expressions, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening, Oral Expressions.

   C. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening, Oral Expressions.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening, Oral Expressions.

2. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Haus

   C. Wasser
   D. Schule
